nom: The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum with Ceramides

avis.texte: I have been using this serum for over 5yrs. I will say it is one of the best hydrating hyaluronic serums! I love how it make my skin glow and feel smooth. It's also excellent under make up.

avis.titre: Amazing results after more than 4 years
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for more than four years, and I absolutely love it. My skin looks amazing, hydrated, smooth, and healthy. It feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin greasy. It has been a consistent part of my skincare routine, and I would definitely recommend it.

avis.titre: Not sure if would buy again
avis.texte: I've only been using this for a couple of weeks. I haven't noticed any difference yet. I like that it has no scent and doesn't pill.

avis.titre: Layers well with their other products
avis.texte: Adds great extra moisturizing with their facial moisturizer. Also along with regular cleansing it helps keep large breakouts at bay for me
The worst HA. No matter how long you let it dry down, it still flakes. I used the whole bottle bc i already bought it and every single time it pills

avis.titre: Inexpensive way to keep your skin hydrated!
avis.texte: I love how this product hidrates my skin, it is a non heavy, non grease formula, safe to use on a daily basis.
bought this because it was cheaper than IT's version. completely disappointed. does nothing.
I first saw this product recommended on the Today show by a dermatologist for a grat price and I thought why not try it. Since then it has been a stable in my beauty care routine.
Great product! Keeps my skin smooth and acne free. The ordinary never disappoints!

Cursed with ever-changing combination skin in addition to 2 types of cystic acne, my skin soaks this up nearly instantly and really helps lock in moisture to help my skin barrier. It makes great strides in preventing painful cystic acne and is an absolute staple to my entire routine. When my routine needs to run lean, this makes the cut every time. I hope this never gets discontinued.
Goes on sticky. Dries to a flaky mess that must be removed. There's nothing good about this product. I tried it several times with the same result.

avis.titre: My new go to for Hyaluronic Acid
avis.texte: This product is amazing! It works great, feels great, and is a great value. Highly recommend. So excited to have found my new product. Can't believe I've been spending so much money on other products when this works better than some and the same as some of those expensive ones.

avis.titre: I love this product and I buy it again and again and again
avis.texte: this is so good and hydrate your skin and also is really good for under makeup

avis.titre: A great product at a great price
avis.texte: This product has made my skin so soft and toned. I have received so many compliments about how beautiful my skin looks since I began using it. And it is so reasonably priced.
Works very well, I have no problems with this product. Very happy
I use this in my routine every night. Have been using it a couple years now and won't go without it.
I've been using this for several years, twice a day. I smooth it on my face, neck and chest. It really calms and smooths the wrinkles and makes my skin look younger!

avis.titre: I used this everyday!! Definitely recommend
avis.texte: I recently tried this original serum and it honestly became one of my favorite skincare steps. The formula is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling greasy or sticky, which makes it perfect for everyday use.
I started using this product because it was a comparable cheaper serum to Estee' Lauders Advanced Night Repair. I've used both and Ordinary's version is just as good and a fraction of the cost!
I buy It often, it's so good. Almost 40 and this product has been wonder for my skin and Hydration.
I've been told hyaluronic Acid is important in skin care and this product works great.
I have sensitive skin and this is the only hyaluronic acid that does not irritate my skin. Works wonders.
It makes my skin soft and gradually makes the dark spots lighter. I can feel my skin hydrated.

I have been using this serum for a few weeks and I really like it. I apply it right after washing my face and it feels very light and smooth. My skin absorbs it quickly and does not feel sticky at all. I have noticed that my skin looks more fresh and a little brighter. It also makes my other skincare products work better. I like the soft herbal scent because it feels calming. I think it helps my skin feel more hydrated and balanced. I will continue using it in my daily routine.

I added this to my nighttime skincare routine and I wear it after I tone with toning pads. The areas of my face that would be dry when I wake up and during the colder seasons have gone away and I don't notice any skin peeling from dryness anymore

This is my third bottle of Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid. I like that it is affordable and it works well at plumping and hydrating. However, a lot of the time it does pill on me, especially if I wear it under make up. I have tried several ways of applying it to avoid pillage. I do let it dry down. Otherwise, I would give it five stars.
Love this product, I'm 75 yrs old and it hydrates my face and neck wonderfully. Really great price!
This is the best product for the money, that you cannot beat. I did the Google search and this product came up many times. My Dermatologist even recommended this to me. I love it

avis.titre: I will never understand this product.
avis.texte: For the life of me I will never be able to understand how a hyaluronic acid serum with ceramides is drying, but it is. this serum leaves my skin dry, tight and uncomfortable and causes the most atrocious pilling. Forget layering it with other products or makeup, this serum sabotages everything it touches. I've re purchased this so many times and it's the same result. Exfoliated and bare skinned or mixed with another serum or moisturizer, doesn't matter. Here come the gross little peeling pills with an awful drying sensation. for whatever reason it won't work with my skin, so beware, you may be the same way. doesn't matter how cheap it is if it's still a complete waste of money.

I have used so many products over the years-this one is a must in my routine! I start w/the ordinary Vitamin C serum then use this HA serum followed by moisturizer(+sunscreen in AM). KAPOW! Youthful, brighter skin after 2 weeks. Works like magic with Vitamin c. I've been using this consistently for a year and when I run out my skin is more dull. Stick with it-works like a charm
Love this product. Apply onto a damp face, then apply HA, then moisturize!

been using this serum since i was 10 (when i first started getting acne) and it's a DREAM, i've purchased it multiple times and i love it. makes my skin clearer, and moisturizes without clogging pores. DEF recommend!

avis.titre: My daughters face swelled so bad we had to go to urgent care
avis.texte: Why does this product hide the main warning under the label? ALL warnings should be clearly visible. I should not have to peel back the label to find it. This company should be paying my medical bills. I would share a picture but my daughter is a minor. It was awful.

avis.titre: I wanted to love it but it dries out my skin so bad!
avis.texte: I started using it after cleanser and toner and my face would get super tight and dry. Then i realized my face needed to be wet when applying to lock in the moisture. I tried that but it still makes my skin SO dry i have to immediately put on moisturizer. I wish it worked..

avis.titre: this is my 34th time buying this yes I'm serious
avis.texte: it clear my acne and I don't break out anymore I go through this after 2 weeks and it's so good I buy it again its one of my everyday necessities
I'm not sure if the formula has changed but whenever i use this my skin starts piling .Do not recommend

I tire of mositurizers that make many claims, are expensive, and rarely deliver. However, I am 73 and wanted a simple mositurizer that didn't break the bank and truly made my skin look sift and Dewey. Well if you are on the fence about this product don't be. I am loving it and will continue to purchase.

I don't understand all of the compliments for this product. I was expecting a dewy, hydrating serum and was very shocked how quickly it dried on my face and made it look dry and wrinkled. Not moisturizing at all. Will be returning.
Great product, but most importantly, Maneen provided the most amazing customer service. I will go out of my way to purchase from this location!

avis.titre: I go through this like water
avis.texte: When I tell you this serum changed the game for my skincare routine, I mean it! I use this product twice a day on my cold midwestern winter dry skin and it works wonders. It is lightweight, sits well under/on top of your other products and is fragrance free for my sensitive skin girlies. I love The Ordinary products and their straightforward formulations to keep skin reactions to a minimum. Apply this on slightly damp skin to maximize affectiveness.

avis.titre: A necessity for my routine. Twice a day!
avis.texte: LOVE IT!! Excellent texture, both instant and long term results. I enjoy this. It's like a smoothie for my skin.

I really did like the feeling of this on my skin but i now realized this is what's causing my breakouts. I paired this with the niacinimide which i have been using for a long time so i never had any issues with it. I started using this serum not that long ago and just bought another bottle which i will be returning. After i read the reviews i figured out this is what my skin doesn't like.

Hyaluronic serum was reformulated to include ceramides. The serum no longer gives me the "tacky" feeling I prefer. The Ordinary realized that may people prefer the original formula and hasnit available, but Ulta does not.

avis.titre: Not sure if I would recommend buy.
avis.texte: Used it a few times didn't see any change in the mature skin. Could be because I'm older or need to use it for a longer period of time.

avis.titre: Love this serum, glass bottle got broken after 2 weeks
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. I understand why they put it I a glass bottle, but I knew it was only a matter of time before the bottle would get knocked off my sink and break. Took less than 2 weeks, and so I have to order a new one - good thing the price is so good!
This serum made my skin more dry.It is also kinda sticky and dries fast when you rub it on face.

Ive had such a concern with the wrinkles around my lips. Almost like the lines that smokers get. I assume it's because I use a straw however over the last two weeks my lips feel fuller and the lines are almost completely gone. I pair this with a hydrating lip moisturizer they have and it's made such a difference with those areas of concern.

A couple of years ago, my skin was going through a lot. I did my research and a lot of people were recommending this product. I have sensitive skin so I took a chance on it. And it didn't disappoint me.
Starting using this for my dry skin for these winter months and ive been loving it so far. I also use it before applying my makeup and it leaves my skin looking really good!
This product is perfect for my skin since it has no retinol or stuff in it that aren't really good for my skin
Been using this for almost a week now can immediately tell a difference !! It hydrates my skin amazingly

avis.titre: I use every day- twice a day!
avis.texte: Love many products from The Ordinary - this is one of my favorites. I really do use it twice a day, every day. Makes a big difference in my older, very dry skin.

avis.titre: Why change formula? Now I'm not buying
avis.texte: Glad I read the reviews before buying this! I wonder how many customers you lose by changing formulas and causing people to leave negative reviews. Do better :)

I will always love the ordinarys dropper packaging and feel as if their products last for a while! I will never have a problem repurchasing them because they are always worth it. I let my sister try it (she has sensetive skin) and after rubbing it in it burned her skin and caused her to experience a bit of redness and stinging.
Ive been using a variety of The Ordinary products over the last 8 years. The Hyaluronic Acid is part of my every day, twice a day routine. I can tell a difference if I don't use it.

Tried this serum and my face had a terrible reaction. Got a red rash and breakouts all over my face. My face itches and burns. I returned it and ulta was great about twking it back. Hoping it heals up quickly.
I absolutely love this product. Very moisturizing and will make a great primer as well.
This product did nothing for my dry skin. My skin is flaking and dry
It does what it's supposed to do, and it is reasonably priced.
I like to use this under my regular moisturizer. I've been using it for about a year. It's simply and at a very good price. Simple packaging and not lots of fancy ingredients so price is kept low.

I hadn't used hyaluronic acid for a long time, have experimented in the past with the good molecules HA but I keep coming back to this one! the slip and moisture this provides is unmatched, definitely should be used with water on your face to help lock in additional moisture, but the tightening/plumping effect is definitely there right when you apply the product and wears well throughout the day and overnight. could be user 2x daily but I typically layer it at nighttime for extra moisture :)

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: It's so good during the cold weather and it's very affordable. Don't sleep on this serum.
I bought because I was struggling with dry skin and after using this product for a week, my skin has gotten progressively worse. Its super red and I now have chemical burns everywhere. DO NOT BUY!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Love this product it has improve my skin,my skin is very smooth and my wrinkles have lessened.

I always struggled with dry face patches in the winter (between my eyebrows, nose, chin, etc) and since I've been using this once a day after washing my face and toner, I have definitely not had this struggle anymore.
I have been buying this for several years. I put two or three drops in my favorite face lotion and it makes it into a high-end face product!
Great product for the price point. Haven't used an Ordinary product that wasn't good.

avis.titre: Plumps, erase fine lines, helps with tone.
avis.texte: Wow, 3rd product for TO that changed my sking for the best. Doesn´t clog pores
I'm on my second bottle of this serum and for the price you can't beat it. Leaves my skin soft, smooth, hydrated and glowing! Wears great under moisturizer and makeup with no piling.

avis.titre: Staple of my skin care routine
avis.texte: Boosts my skin care to the next level, if I don't use it before my moisturizer I can really tell the difference

Love this product! I've used quite harsh acne treatments while using this serum and it has done a wonderful job at preventing dryness! i love the ordinary and this product is cheap for how effective it is.

I like The Ordinary brand is inexpensive and works. Thus far I like this product, it is a bit tacky but nothing I can't deal with. I use this under a dewy moisturizer leaving my skin dewy, which is what I like. Try it and be your own judge.

I can't tell you how many bottles of this I've been through. I used it everyday, twice a day, and have never had a problem with it. It hydrates really well and absorbs into the skin fairly quickly, I even use it under makeup and it works great! My only con is I wish they offered a larger size!

I've been using this after cleanser morning and night for the last 4 months and it has improved my skin so much! My face is literally so much softer now. This is a must have skincare step for me especially with using a RetinA product since that can make my skin feel tight/dry.

This is one of my staple products and I love it. My skin is always hydrated but not too sticky which is super important since i have ouly skin. I use it everyday, twice a day so it does run out pretty quick but since it's not too expensive I don't mind it as much.
My dermatologist highly recommended it to me and I have been using it regularly. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: I use this every day twice a day I love it
avis.texte: Very good. Similar to La Roche Posay B5 hylaluronic serum. Not sticky, you need to let it absorb for 30-60 seconds so it wont pill under other layers. It plumps my skin beautiful, specifically my smils lines. Will be purchasing a big bottle once my 1 oz runs out. Highly recommend
Im in my late 30's and i swear this has helped my skin sooo much! My coworkers say I do not look my age and I swear it is all due to this.

I bought this product, along with a few others from The Ordinary, & it's destroyed my skin. I used to have smooth, clear skin & after using their products; my skin is dry, flakey, & it BURNS when I used their products!

Most people don't know hyaluronic acid needs to be used on wet skin and the instructions should say so. Putting it on dry left me with sticky skin, it pilled, left little results. I started putting it on my wet face in the morning and letting it air dry, it soaks up to where skin is super soft and hydrated with no residue at all, it just feels like skin. Perfect to hydrate before makeup because moisturizers/lotions would interfere with makeup or make my skin greasy within a couple hours, especially paired with sunscreen.

avis.titre: Hydrating but pills under all lotions and sunscreens
avis.texte: Really wanted to like this, it's hydrating bit impossoble to wear during the day under sunscreen or primer. Pills no matter what sunscreen or primer i use.
It does what it's supposed to do. I really enjoy The Ordinary brand because it doesn't cost a fortune to get better feeling skin.

avis.titre: LOVE This Serum! Great for aging skin
avis.texte: I LOVE this serum. I use it, along with another serum and an essence, and my skin is SO soft and hydrated. I am 43 and while I have always looked younger than my age, my skin was getting dryer and definitely aging. I have a lot of expensive products so I was nervous about a "cheaper" one performing well but I was blown away by this one! This serum has become a staple in my morning/evening routine.

avis.titre: I would totally buy this again
avis.texte: This product works amazing is the only thing that has been working for me and I have tried many products. It's fairly priced compared to other products. It does suck not being able to find it at target anymore although going to Ulta is always a good experience

I have dry skin, and its been hard finding a product that actually keeps my face FEELING hydrated. My nose has always felt dry and slightly itchy, and my cheeks had closed comedones everywhere! I consulted with one of the Ulta employees (who was SO helpful), and they told me to add some Hyaluronic into my routine for that extra hydration. While I was browsing, another employee came and told me this product was amazing! The price tag seemed good too, and I bought it. My nose is no longer feeling dry, and my comedones finally went away! If you have dryness on your skin, PLEASE get this, its so affordable and feels AMAZING! The bottle looks small, but you're only supposed to use a bit. Its been two weeks and mine hasn't budged! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

avis.titre: Likely it's only been a couple of weeks
avis.texte: Love the simplicity smoothness and texture of my face giving the fact I have mature skin
My skin looks so great after using the Hyaluronic Acid 2% the first week! Excellent product!
An absolute staple in my everyday skincare routine, the only thing that clears my skin up! Higoy recommended for anyone with combination skin.
I can not stand the smell of this! I will not use the rest of the bottle.
It's very hydrating without clogging my pores. I use it in summer and winter cause it's not too heavy

avis.titre: Not for me (other hyaluronic serums do not do this)
avis.texte: Although I didn't experience the flaking that some other users mentioned, the serum absorbed well and felt fine. However, after a week of use, I noticed it caused small breakouts on my skin.

Started using this serum for more hydrated skin. During the first week of use, my skin did appear more hydrated; but, after a couple of weeks, my skin started breaking out. I typically don't experience breakouts; and this serum has been the only recent change in my skincare routine.

I've been using this product for years. It keeps my skin happy and moisturized. I pair it with the plant derived Squalane (which I also recommend ) and it keeps my face and skin happy in every season.
